shell.verifyEmailBanner: Your email address is not verified yet. Open the verification link we sent you.

validation.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.
validation.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.displayNameTooLong: That display name is too long.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Carry on building and preserving your family record.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute, and you can start straight away.
register.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Pick something you will remember and nobody else would guess.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email. If it has an account, we will send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Changing it ends every session currently signed in to this account.
reset.signsOutEverywhere: This signs your account out on every device.
reset.missingTokenBody: The reset link has no token in it. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.successBody: Thank you. Your account is ready.
verify.failedBody: That link is not valid, or it has expired.
verify.missingToken: The verification link has no token in it.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: How you appear to others, the language of the interface, and where you are signed in.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: The browsers and devices currently signed in to this account.

logoutAll.title: Security
logoutAll.heading: Sign out everywhere
logoutAll.body: Ends every session, including this one. Use it if you think someone else has access to your account.
logoutAll.confirmBody: You will have to sign in again everywhere, including here.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: That email address already has an account.
errors.validationFailed: Some of what you entered is not valid.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You may not perform this action.
errors.server: The server is having trouble. Try again shortly.
errors.clanNotFound: This clan does not exist, or you are not a member of it.
errors.branchNotFound: That branch does not exist in this clan.
errors.invalidClanCode: That does not look like a join code.
errors.duplicatePendingRequest: You already have a request waiting. Wait for an answer, or withdraw it first.
errors.membershipExists: You are already a member of this clan.
errors.versionConflict: Somebody else changed this while you were editing. Reload and try again.
errors.cycleDetected: That would make somebody their own ancestor, or move a branch underneath itself.
errors.lastAdminProtected: This clan would be left with nobody able to administer it. Make somebody else an administrator first.
errors.outOfScope: That is outside the part of the family you look after. You can only change what your own branch covers.
errors.escalationBlocked: You can only give somebody a permission you already hold yourself, and only where you already hold it.
errors.grantAlreadyExists: They already have that permission here.
errors.subtreeUnavailable: Limiting a permission to one person and their descendants becomes available once the family tree exists.
errors.personNotFound: That person does not exist in this clan.
errors.invalidRelationship: That relationship cannot be recorded as it stands. Check the people you chose.
errors.dateRangeInvalid: Those dates cannot both be right. Check the year you entered.
errors.nodeAlreadyLinked: Somebody is already recorded as that person. Ask an editor if you think that is wrong.
errors.userAlreadyLinkedInClan: That account is already recorded as somebody else in this family. Unlink them first.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: This page calls the server directly, through the same network layer the whole application uses.
health.hint: Check that the API is running with the dev profile and that PostgreSQL is up.

error.unexpectedBody: This section could not be displayed. Reload the page.

onboarding.title: Start your family record
onboarding.subtitle: Either create a clan and invite your relatives, or join one that somebody in your family has already started.

create.title: Create a clan
create.body: Set up the record for your family. You will get a code to share with relatives so they can join.

join.title: Join with a code
join.body: Somebody in your family has already started the record. Enter the code they gave you.

field.name: Clan name
field.surnameHint: Used to build the join code. Diacritics are removed, so Nguyễn becomes NGUYEN.
field.codeTooltip: Generated once and never changed, so a code you share stays valid.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name for the clan.

create.title: Create a clan
create.subtitle: Only the name is required. Everything else can be filled in later.
create.codeBody: Share this with your relatives. Anyone who enters it can ask to join, and you decide who comes in.
create.copyUnavailable: Could not copy automatically — select the code and copy it.

join.title: Join a clan
join.subtitle: Enter the code a relative shared with you. We will show you which family it belongs to before you ask to join.

field.message: A note for whoever approves this

placeholder.message: Who you are, and how you are related.

join.alreadyMember: You are already in this clan.
join.alreadyRequested: You have already asked to join. Wait for an answer.
join.sent: Request sent. You will see the answer on your profile.

settings.title: Clan settings
settings.subtitle: The name, where the family comes from, and the record you keep about it.
settings.readOnly: Only the person who created this clan can change it for now.

delete.title: Delete this clan
delete.heading: Delete the clan
delete.body: The clan disappears for everyone in it. There is a 30-day window in which it can be brought back.
delete.confirmBody: Everyone loses access to it. It can be restored within 30 days.

notFound.title: Clan not found
notFound.body: This clan does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

branch.title: Branches
branch.subtitle: The chi and nhánh your family divides into. Drag a branch onto another to move it, and everything beneath it moves too.
branch.readOnly: Only the person who created this clan can change its branches for now.
branch.addChild: Add a branch under this one

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name for the branch.

archive.confirmBody: It stays in the record and keeps its members, but nothing new can be added to it. Branches beneath it must be archived first.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who is in this clan, and who has asked to be.

inbox.approveBody: Which branch do they belong to? Leave it empty to admit them to the clan without placing them yet.
inbox.rejectBody: The reason is shown to the person who asked. They are a relative — say something useful.

remove.confirmBody: They lose access to this clan. They can ask to join again.

leave.confirmBody: You lose access to it and would have to ask to join again.

myRequests.title: My join requests
myRequests.subtitle: Requests you have sent, and what came of them.
myRequests.empty: You have not asked to join any clan.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Who may change what, and where. Every permission is given to a person for a part of the family — never to a role.

description.CLAN_VIEW: Read the family tree, person details and the member list.
description.TREE_EDIT: Add, change and remove people and the links between them.
description.MEMBER_APPROVE: Decide who joins, and remove members.
description.NODE_CLAIM_APPROVE: Decide who is linked to which person in the tree.
description.ROLE_MANAGE: Give and take back permissions, within your own scope.
description.CLAN_ADMIN: Clan settings, the branch structure, and everything above.

summary.branch: Can {{permission}} in {{branch}} and everything under it.
summary.subtree: Can {{permission}} for one person and their descendants.

scope.subtreeUnavailable: One person and their descendants — only somebody who manages roles for the whole clan can grant this

grant.title: Give a permission
grant.scopeAfterPermission: Choose a permission first — where you may give it depends on what it is.
grant.expiresHint: Leave empty for a permission that stands until somebody takes it back.
grant.nothingToGrant: There is nothing you can pass on yet. You can only give a permission you hold yourself, in a branch you manage.

drawer.title: Member
drawer.holdsNothing: They can read the clan, and nothing more.

denied.title: You do not manage permissions here
denied.body: Only somebody who manages roles in this clan can see who holds what. Ask an administrator, or the person who looks after your branch.

tree.title: Family tree
tree.subtitle: Everyone in the book, by generation. Open a name to see the family around them.
tree.emptyHelp: Start with the founding ancestor — đời 1 — and hang the rest of the family below them.

field.notesHelp: Kept as written. Formatting is preserved; anything that could run is removed.

placeholder.posthumousName: The name used at the giỗ

validation.nameRequired: A name is required — everything else can wait.
validation.anchorRequired: Choose the person this one attaches to.

readOnly.branch: This person is in {{branch}}, which is outside the part of the tree you can edit.
readOnly.noBranch: This person is not placed in a branch, so only a clan-wide editor can change them.
readOnly.generic: This person is outside the part of the tree you can edit.

delete.title: Remove {{name}} from the tree?
delete.body: They stay in the record and an administrator can put them back within 30 days.
delete.bodyWithChildren_one: They stay in the record and can be restored within 30 days. {{count}} child is recorded under them: {{names}}.
delete.bodyWithChildren_other: They stay in the record and can be restored within 30 days. {{count}} children are recorded under them: {{names}}.

deleted.title: Recently removed
deleted.help: Removed within the last 30 days. Restoring puts a person back exactly as they were.

conflict.title: This record changed while you were editing
conflict.body: Somebody else saved a change to this person. Reload to see theirs before making yours — saving now would overwrite it.

editor.roleHelp: Leave empty to take it from their recorded gender.
editor.removeParentBody: The link is removed; neither person leaves the tree. Generations below are recalculated.
editor.unionTypeHelp: One principal marriage per person. A second wife is recorded as a secondary marriage.
editor.attachChild: Attach a child to a marriage
editor.attachChildHelp: Links the child to both partners, so the book shows whose child is whose.

search.title: Find a relative
search.subtitle: Diacritics are optional — "nguyen van an" finds "Nguyễn Văn An".

tree.truncated: Only part of the tree is loaded — there are more generations below.

canvas.label: Family tree diagram
canvas.hint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Arrow keys move between siblings and generations, Enter opens a person, space collapses a branch.
canvas.searchPlaceholder: Find someone and jump to them

claims.title: Your place in the family tree
claims.subtitle: Find the person in the record who is you, and ask an editor to confirm it. Being linked to an entry does not let you edit the tree.

candidate.noFamily: No parents or children recorded yet

browse.empty: Nobody in the record matches. Try a shorter name, or ask an editor — you may not have been added yet.
browse.alreadyYoursHelp: One entry per account in each family. To be linked to somebody else instead, ask an editor to unlink you first.

submit.title: Are you {{name}}?
submit.done: Request sent. An editor will review it.
submit.alreadyLinked: You are already recorded as {{name}} in this family. Ask an editor to unlink you before claiming another entry.
submit.reviewed: An editor will check this against the record before it is confirmed. Being linked shows relatives who you are; it does not let you edit the tree.
submit.evidenceLabel: Anything that helps them recognise you (optional)
submit.evidencePlaceholder: For example: my father is Nguyễn Văn An, I am the youngest of four.

inbox.approveBody: {{name}} will be shown on the tree as {{person}}, and can edit their own photo and notes.
inbox.approveNoEditRights: This does not give them permission to edit the family tree. Permissions are granted separately, on the Permissions page.
inbox.rejectBody: Say why, so they can send a better one. They will see this.

mine.title: Your claims
mine.subtitle: Entries in a family record you have asked to be recognised as.
mine.empty: You have not asked to be linked to anybody.

assign.title: Who is {{person}}?
assign.confirmBody: {{name}} will be shown on the tree as {{person}}.
assign.noEditRights: This does not give them permission to edit the family tree.

unlink.title: Unlink {{person}}?
unlink.bodySelf: You will no longer be shown as this person. Nothing is removed from the family record, and you can ask to be linked again.
unlink.bodyOther: This account will no longer be shown as this person. Nothing is removed from the family record.

self.title: What you can change here
self.scope: Because this is your own entry you can change your photo and your notes. Your name, generation, dates and family links are the family's record of you — ask an editor to change those.
self.notesHelp: Shown to everybody in the family.
self.propagateAvatarHelp: Your account photo is copied onto this entry, and updated whenever you change it.
self.propagateDisplayName: Show my account name as an alias
self.propagateDisplayNameHelp: Added as an alias only. The name recorded in the book is never changed.

banner.title: Are you in this family tree?
banner.body: Find the entry that is you and ask an editor to confirm it, so relatives know who you are.

message.CLAIM_SUBMITTED: {{name}} says they are {{person}}, and is waiting for an answer.
message.CLAIM_DECIDED_REJECTED: Your request to be recorded as {{person}} was declined. {{reason}}
message.unknown: Something happened in one of your families.
